stem.text: The diagram shows graphs of various quantities plotted against time for an object dropped from a stationary balloon high in the atmosphere.

stem.alt: Graph titled graph 1: a curve rising from the origin and levelling off to a horizontal line; horizontal axis labelled time, vertical axis unlabelled.
Graph titled graph 2: a straight line rising from the origin; horizontal axis labelled time, vertical axis unlabelled.
Graph titled graph 3: a curve falling from a point on the vertical axis and levelling off to a horizontal line; horizontal axis labelled time, vertical axis unlabelled.
Graph titled graph 4: a horizontal line above the origin; horizontal axis labelled time, vertical axis unlabelled.

A.text: Graph 1 is acceleration against time and graph 3 is resultant force against time.

B.text: Graph 1 is acceleration against time and graph 4 is resultant force against time.

C.text: Graph 3 is acceleration against time and graph 1 is velocity against time.

D.text: Graph 3 is acceleration against time and graph 2 is velocity against time.
